caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of a female figure and a separate garment, both rendered with attention to color and fabric texture. The central figure is wearing a large, off-white, voluminous bonnet adorned with black ribbon and lace trim, with her face visible beneath it, showing brown eyes and a faint smile. She is dressed in a dark greenish-gray cloak or cape that is outlined with a white and blue patterned border and tied at the neck with a black ribbon. Underneath the cloak, a deep rose-pink dress is visible, extending to the floor. The figure’s hands, gloved in light yellow, are clasped together at the front. To the upper right of the main figure, there is a separate illustration of the cloak and bonnet viewed from the back, featuring the same greenish-gray fabric and patterned border, and showing the pink dress peeking out below. The background is an unadorned, light beige color.
title: Doll
